pictures.author: James Emery
pictures.observations: Actually viewed: tall narrow silver/pale concave face, gently curved cut top, thin raised side edges, horizontal surface joints and low inscription. Commons photo links Q56696132. Viewed only.

pictures.author: Daniel Case
pictures.observations: Actually viewed: long approach, narrow upright profile and near-ground base; people supply a rough scale cue only, not a calibrated measurement.

pictures.author: Avishai Teicher
pictures.observations: Actually viewed: concave face and thick edge, real raised lettering (not copied), Children's Memorial pillars behind/left. Supports approximate approach-facing assignment.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Pillar of Heroism, Yad Vashem: tall independent curved C-section concrete memorial with an open concave face, closed thin curved top/side edges, satin-metal inner facing, sparse horizontal facing joints at near levels and a small closed contact footing. Preserve its narrow silhouette and open cross-section at every LOD. No copied inscription, invented writing, broad plaza, surrounding truncated blocks, trees, benches or independent campus structures.
